verdict.rationale: Mixpanel is an analytics SaaS that ships AI features (MCP server, AI summaries, agents), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documented control or policy preventing customer data from being used to train AI models. GDPR deletion APIs and EU Data Residency are adjacent privacy features, not an AI-training opt-out, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
